atlas_contracts.name: Loading classical data: QRAM, state preparation from classical data, block encoding of dense matrices
atlas_contracts.qspm_use_html: Haiqu Entangled Manifold Embedding (EME) — Linear-depth loading of multi-dimensional Core20PLUS5 socio-clinical patient vectors.

atlas_contracts.caveat: General QRAM / arbitrary amplitude loading incurs O(√N) T-count; low-qubit EME avoids QRAM overhead on structured tabular data.

atlas_contracts.caveat: No unconditional speedup guarantee; permutation-invariant subspaces on fixed subsystems admit polynomial classical simulation.
